text: Hey, wanna walk the boardwalk after work thurs? Been cooped up marking all week
Thurs I've got a 4:30 that might run late could do 6?
6 works. Dress warm, its gonna be windy off the harbour
Always is. How's the grade 11 pile
75 essays on gatsby at least 20 are the same sparknotes summary
Oof. Do you just give them a zero or do you go back to them
Half and half. Some of them clearly had no idea what the question was and I feel bad docking them
Fair. My clinic is the opposite, three people this week did the same thing to their back at the gym and now everyone's a "rush"
So is everyone just deadlifting their way into your office
Yes. One guy asked if he could just "walk it off"
I said walk it slowly he's back friday
Thurs still good if the marking is done by then lol
Should be. I'm going to bed prob soon, 5:45 wake up
